name: Nawaya
overview: Two families, the wealthy Sheikha's family living in luxury and extravagance, and the poor Umm Rakan family with a low standard of living, both migrated from Kuwait to Dubai following the Iraqi invasion of Kuwait in 1990 and lived in a place One until the invasion ended, then they returned to Kuwait and the children of both families became young adults, and Rakan fell in love with Basma.
